scope: Source, test and actual storage-contract review of fixed POINT expansion and generic scalar lowering. Current host scheduling/canvas reset source review with separately scoped existing actual-browser correctness evidence. No Chrome session, timing benchmark or repeated native replay was run during this review.
pointChecks: Only a complete discarded-result writeLocalPoint statement to a fixed in-bounds private frame offset expands. Dynamic pointers, escaped frames, overlapping views, name collisions and observed returns keep the complete original source.

The point expression executes once. The x getter and its integer/semantic conversion complete before the y getter, preserving the original writeLocalPoint effect and exception order. Both widths and offsets match the original adjacent DWORD stores.
The existing generic scalar proof still validates every frame use, width, overlap and discarded write result after expansion. Every rejection returns the original unexpanded source.
Explicit retained bytes select a byte-frame function built from the original unexpanded source. Specialized water/shore partial scalar passes occur before this generic expansion and remain unchanged.

pointTestsReviewed.scope: Read end to end; producing agent/root runs and native replay are separate evidence, not claimed executed by this reviewer.

hostChecks: An unchanged canvas receives a complete context reset; older contexts receive one width reset. Dimension changes retain both assignments and the original font. Buffer pixel-read context remains unchanged; the visible blit context uses its default backend.

Hidden callbacks exit before simulation and preserve one nextPaint request. Visibility resume preserves the remaining positive delay, deduplicates pending callbacks and respects modal, closed, error and frozen states. No missed-frame simulation catchup is added.

Optional requestAnimationFrame instrumentation observes completed canvas frame ids only. The report labels this rendering-opportunity sampling and does not equate it with physical monitor presentation.
Console output replaces raw presentation samples with their count only after the complete raw report is written.

browserEvidence.scope: Six actual browser state/raster comparisons and visible-blit equality. The unchanged reset helper matches the current hash. This earlier report pins the host before the subsequent visibility-only edit; it is not claimed to cover the entire current host source.

Current host hash matches. A real hidden Chrome tab executes zero candidate paints and zero simulation-time change versus eight old paints; visible resume uses six ordinary timestep updates without catchup.

focusedHostValidation: Current canvas, scheduler and optional presentation sources retain the earlier nine passing focused tests. The console-only truncation passed node --check; there is no new runtime edit in this review.

additionalDiagnosticEvidence.scope: Optional setup-gate code was added afterward to the measurement tool. Its own current source/test/browser receipt proves complete baseline/current image, RNG, frame and command-history equality. Default sampling protocol remains unchanged.
